notes.title: Released TimeK 1.2.3
notes.content:
We have released TimeK 1.2.3.

Added a mechanism to mitigate FPS drops when drawing load is high.

tags.feature: Added a mechanism to mitigate FPS drops when drawing load is high.

notes.title: Released TimeK 1.2.2
notes.content:
We have released TimeK 1.2.2.

[list]
[*] Adjusted hints for time limits.
[*] Fixed the issue with rewinding a few seconds during time limits.
[*] Fixed the issue with BGM when retrying during time manipulation.
[*] Added support for button images when using DualSense.
[*] Changed to stop the sound when there is no focus.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43725375/b902913295496d97f4e5e184135f1f39a5652208.png[/img]

tags.bug: [*] Fixed the issue with rewinding a few seconds during time limits.

tags.feature: [*] Added support for button images when using DualSense.

tags.balance_change: [*] Changed to stop the sound when there is no focus.

notes.title: Released TimeK 1.1.0
notes.content:
Released TimeK 1.1.0.

[list]
[*] Modified to allow progression to the next level after playing a level once.
[*] Changed to display the number of cleared levels in the level selection.
[*] Boss levels are now unlocked based on the number of cleared levels.
[*] Added hint messages for level unlocking.
[*] Fixed various minor bugs.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43725375/cd5554b227b165f07e140141f6f2eb614a004351.png[/img]

tags.feature: Modified to allow progression to the next level after playing a level once.
Changed to display the number of cleared levels in the level selection.
Boss levels are now unlocked based on the number of cleared levels.
Added hint messages for level unlocking.

notes.title: TimeK1.0.5 Release
notes.content:
[h3]TimeK1.0.5 has been released.[/h3]

[list]
[*]Added a message that allows recovery by rewinding when approaching the time limit.
[*]Added a message that the ability to rewind a few seconds when failed can also be accessed from the menu.
[*]Fixed some text issues.
[*]Fixed a bug where an effect would occur when rewinding to 0 seconds using Reverse.
[/list]
